title: Serialization as a transition table
statement: For every machine $M$ in code normal form, its serialization is the pairing of the binary representation of its state bound with the unary encoding of its initial state followed by the two transition tables, in order: the table for choice $0$ and then the table for choice $1$. Each table lists the actions for all states, input readings, and work-tape readings.
hypotheses_covered: A machine $M$ in code normal form, with its two work-tape nondeterministic transition functions
